[Root.GetCouncillorLetterGreeting]. [Root.GetCathayanLetterBlessing].

The Jade Viceroy, who keeps the western marches of the Celestial Empire in the name of the Dragon Emperor, wishes to know the lords beyond the Great Bastion better. My [From.Liege.GetMasterMistress] has sent me west on the long road, and it would honour me to visit your court and [From.GetCGMission].

I await your answer with the patience of jade.

[Root.GetCouncillorLetterGreeting]. [Root.GetCathayanLetterBlessing].

As a loyal tributary of the Dragon Throne, you will understand that the Jade Viceroy must look after the Emperor's western children. My [From.Liege.GetMasterMistress] has sent me to your demesne to see that the bonds between our lands stay strong. I shall visit your court and [From.GetCGMission].

Prepare a fitting welcome.
The servants of the [From.Liege.GetTitle] are always welcome here.
I have no time to entertain guests from the far East.
The [From.GetJobTitle] of §Y[From.Liege.GetTitledFirstName]§!, §Y[From.GetTitledFirstName]§!, will visit your court.\n
Your refusal is a great insult to §Y[From.Liege.GetTitledFirstName]§! and [From.Liege.GetHerHis] [From.GetJobTitle] §Y[From.GetTitledFirstName]§!.\n

After a tour of [Root.Capital.GetName] and a fortnight at my court, [From.GetJobTitle] [From.GetDynName] takes [From.GetHerHis] leave. My own [corresponding_councilor.GetJobTitle], [corresponding_councilor.GetTitledFirstName], saw to every detail, from the order of the dishes to the number of bows at the gate, and not one thing went amiss. The [From.GetJobTitle] goes back east with [From.GetCGMissionOutcome] for the Jade Viceroy, and with kind words about my court.
Let the Viceroy hear of us.

When the welcoming feast is over, [From.GetJobTitle] [From.GetDynName] and I walk the walls of [Root.Capital.Capital.GetName] to finish our talk under the moons. Then streaks of fire cross the sky, one after another, and the [From.GetJobTitle] goes grey in the face. 'The Dragons of Heaven are angry,' the translator mutters. Before dawn my guests are gone, back down the eastern road without a word of farewell.

When the welcoming feast is over, [From.GetJobTitle] [From.GetDynName] and I walk the walls of [Root.Capital.Capital.GetName] to finish our talk under the moons. Streaks of fire cross the sky, and the old court astrologers would have wailed at the omen. We are both too old for that. The [From.GetJobTitle] laughs and says the Dragons of Heaven are only lighting our way home after too much rice wine.
Wait, come back! We were getting on so well!
§Y[From.GetJobTitle] [From.GetDynName]§! leaves at once, sure that Heaven has cursed the visit.\n
Then let us raise one more cup to them.

[From.GetJobTitle] [From.GetDynName] arrives tomorrow, and the preparations are well in hand. A translator who has walked the Ivory Road twice stands ready. Still, it would be a fine gesture to greet my guest in the tongue of Grand Cathay, with all its rising and falling tones, each of which seems to change the meaning entirely...
I shall spend ALL NIGHT on the most elegant phrases!
An hour or two on a simple greeting should do.
How fortunate that I already speak the tongue.
Better not. The translator knows the tones, I do not.
a long night of study. Your greeting tomorrow will be flawless.
you falling asleep over your study, and being late to the audience.
you making a good attempt at the greeting.
you making a clumsy attempt at the greeting.
You greet your guest flawlessly in the tongue of Grand Cathay.\n
You leave the talking to the translator. §Y[cathayan_guest.GetTitledName]§! is content and goes home in good time.\n

I had the translator teach me not only the sounds, but the grammar and the meaning behind each word, and why the word for 'four' must never be said at a feast. It took the whole night and most of the candles. But the look on [FromFrom.GetJobTitle] [FromFrom.GetDynName]'s [FromFrom.GetFaceDescription] face as I greet [FromFrom.GetHerHim] in flawless Cathayan was worth every hour.
There is more power in words than most [Root.GetMenWomen] know.
Your guest is delighted, and §Y[cathayan_guest.GetTitledName]§! goes home full of praise. §Y[FromFrom.Liege.GetTitle] [FromFrom.Liege.GetDynName]§! will hear of your courtesy.\n

'My [Root.GetLordLady], please wake up!' I sit up with a start, a page of brush strokes stuck to my cheek. The library. 'Your guests are waiting! Forgive me, my [Root.GetLordLady], we searched the whole [Root.Capital.Capital.GetHolding] for you!' I have not even greeted the Viceroy's envoy, and the visit is already a disaster.
Curse these Cathayans and their dawn audiences!
§Y[cathayan_guest.GetTitledName]§! goes home offended. §Y[FromFrom.Liege.GetTitle] [FromFrom.Liege.GetDynName]§! will hear of your manners.\n

I spent an hour with the greeting the translator wrote out for me, and [FromFrom.GetSheHe] coached me again while I dressed. I have no idea what the long phrases mean, but they come out smoothly enough as I bow to [FromFrom.GetJobTitle] [FromFrom.GetDynName], who bows lower still.
That went well, I think!
§Y[FromFrom.GetJobTitle] [FromFrom.GetDynName]§! values the effort, and goes home to §Y[FromFrom.Liege.GetTitle] [FromFrom.Liege.GetDynName]§! with a good report.\n

I spent an hour with the greeting the translator wrote out for me. But as I stood before [FromFrom.GetJobTitle] [FromFrom.GetDynName] this morning, every other word fled my mind, and the ones that stayed came out in the wrong tones. Judging by the translator's face, I may have called my guest's mother a river turtle.
I have never been so ashamed!
You made a fool of yourself, and §Y[FromFrom.GetJobTitle] [FromFrom.GetDynName]§! goes home offended.\n

For [From.GetJobTitle] [From.GetDynName]'s arrival I had a merchant of the Ivory Road find me a robe of the finest Cathayan silk, with all the proper ornaments. Yet when I came out to greet my guest, [From.GetSheHe] went rigid. Later the translator explained, very quietly, that the five-clawed dragon on my sleeves may be worn by no one but the family of the Dragon Emperor himself.
Guards! Bring me that merchant, and my money!
Well, at least I looked magnificent.
§Y[From.GetJobTitle] [From.GetDynName]§! goes home offended. [From.GetHerHisCap] [From.Liege.GetMasterMistress], §Y[From.Liege.GetTitle] [From.Liege.GetDynName]§!, will surely hear of it.\n

Walking in the gardens with [From.GetJobTitle] [From.GetDynName], I remark on the clear sky. The translator repeats my words, and after a long silence [From.GetDynName] answers with great warmth. It seems [From.GetSheHe] took my small talk for an elegant saying about the Dragon Emperor, the Son of Heaven, under whose rule no cloud may darken the sky.

Walking in the gardens with [From.GetJobTitle] [From.GetDynName], I remark on the clear sky, and quote an old verse about the sun on the Jade Sea. My guest finishes it from memory, and we spend the afternoon trading verses like scholars at the Imperial examinations.
Who knew the weather could be so fruitful?
§Y[From.GetJobTitle] [From.GetDynName]§! goes home, sure that you praised the §Y[From.Offmap.Ruler.GetMediumCathayanEmperorName]§!. Word of your wisdom will reach the Dragon Throne.\n

[From.GetTitledName], the [From.GetJobTitle] sent by [offmap_cathay.Governor.GetTitledFirstName], has died at my court. It is a sad loss, and it leaves me with the delicate task of telling the Jade Viceroy that [From.GetHerHis] envoy will not be coming home.

[From.GetTitledName], the [From.GetJobTitle] sent by [offmap_cathay.Governor.GetTitledFirstName], is in a cell. However it came to this, the visit is over, and I have no idea how to word the letter to the Jade Viceroy.

[From.GetTitledName], the [From.GetJobTitle] sent by [offmap_cathay.Governor.GetTitledFirstName], has vanished without a trace. The visit is over, and I have no idea how to word the letter to the Jade Viceroy.
Have my scribes write to the [offmap_cathay.Governor.GetTitle], with a gift.
The [offmap_cathay.Governor.GetTitle] will find out sooner or later.
teach your subjects the harmony of the Celestial Dragon
debate the nature of the gods with your [Root.Religion.GetPriestTitle]s

[Root.GetGovernorLetterGreeting]. [Root.GetCathayanLetterBlessing].\n\nIt has come to the attention of the [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetShortCathayanEmperorName] that the merchants of your lands cheat the caravans of the Celestial Empire on the long roads east. They water the wine, shave the silver and weigh jade with a thumb on the scale. The Jade Viceroy is certain that you will put an end to this at once, before the Emperor's patience, which is long but not endless, runs out.
Curb the privileges of the great trade guilds.
[target_spymaster.GetFirstName] will find the worst of the cheats.
How our merchants trade is no business of the crown.

[From.GetTitledFirstName] has curbed the merchants of my cities, citing their misdeeds with the caravans of Cathay. Many in [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName] say the guilds of my lands are no business of [From.GetTitledFirstName], let alone of some Viceroy beyond the mountains. It might anger the [From.GetTitle], but I could take a public stand.
I will speak out against this misuse of power!
Better to stay in [From.GetFirstName]'s good graces.

Your vassal, [From.GetTitledFirstName], was not pleased that you curbed the merchants of [From.GetHerHis] cities to please the Jade Viceroy. [From.GetSheHeCap] has declared in public that you overstepped your rights in a matter that is [From.GetHerHis] own concern.
[From.GetHerHisCap] merchants had to be kept in line!

Last night [cathayan_courtier.GetBestName] and I talked until dawn about [cathayan_courtier.GetRootMatchingPersonalityStreak]. I must have made a fine impression, for [cathayan_courtier.GetSheHe] says [cathayan_courtier.GetSheHe] will write home to the Celestial Court in praise of the hospitality of [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetName].
A pleasant evening.
Everyone should hear of this.

[cathayan_courtier.GetBestName] has been growing ever more short with me these last weeks, and today something careless slipped from my tongue. [cathayan_courtier.GetSheHeCap] stormed off, crying that the Dragon Emperor himself would hear of this insult.
This may sour our dealings with [offmap_cathay.GetShortName].
Guards, arrest that [cathayan_courtier.GetManWoman]!

My [adventurous_spirit.GetRootRelation] [adventurous_spirit.GetFirstName] kneels before me, eyes shining. 'My [Root.GetLordLady], let me go east! The Jade Viceroy holds court at Taharq, at the very edge of the Celestial Empire. I would carry your name there, learn their ways and bring home the favour of the [the_protector_general.Offmap.Ruler.GetShortCathayanEmperorName]. Please. Let a humble servant win you friends beyond the mountains.'
A splendid idea! Go, with my blessing.
§Y[adventurous_spirit.GetTitledFirstName]§! beams like the sun and runs off to pack.\n
[back_up_target_1.GetTitledFirstName] is better suited to the journey.
§Y[adventurous_spirit.GetTitledFirstName]§! looks crestfallen as §Y[back_up_target_1.GetTitledFirstName]§! is sent in [adventurous_spirit.GetHerHis] place.\n
Forgive me, but [back_up_target_2.GetTitledFirstName] would make a better impression.
§Y[adventurous_spirit.GetTitledFirstName]§! looks crestfallen as §Y[back_up_target_2.GetTitledFirstName]§! is sent in [adventurous_spirit.GetHerHis] place.\n
Absolutely not. You are needed here, [adventurous_spirit.GetFirstName].
§Y[adventurous_spirit.GetTitledFirstName]§! looks crestfallen.\n

I wake one morning before my guards come to rouse me. There is excited chatter in the hall, and when I open the [Root.GetChamberOpening] the [Root.GetCapitalHolding] is a bustle of servants. '[adventurous_spirit.GetTitledFirstName] is back from the court of the Jade Viceroy!' they whisper. 'With carts! And a letter sealed in jade!'
And [adventurous_spirit.GetSheHe] comes bearing gifts? Excellent!
§Y[adventurous_spirit.GetTitledFirstName]§! proudly brings home the favour of the [the_protector_general.Offmap.GetFullName].\n

'The [the_protector_general.Offmap.GetFullName] is a marvel, my [Root.GetLordLady],' says [adventurous_spirit.GetTitledFirstName], as I turn a square-holed copper coin over in my hand. [adventurous_spirit.GetSheHeCap] came home this morning with a chest of trinkets and more tales than a minstrel: of jade warriors that never sleep, of sky lanterns over the river, and of [adventurous_spirit.GetCathayanConvoTopic]. The whole [Root.GetCapitalHolding] wants to hear everything.
Bear with us, [adventurous_spirit.GetFirstName], while my scribes write it all down!
The journey of §Y[adventurous_spirit.GetTitledFirstName]§! to the [the_protector_general.Offmap.GetFullName] was a success!\n

[adventurous_spirit.GetTitledFirstName] reached [Root.Capital.Capital.GetName] late last night, worn out by the road. At today's audience [adventurous_spirit.GetSheHe] mostly looks glad to be home, and I begin to wonder what impression [adventurous_spirit.GetSheHe] made out east. Then [adventurous_spirit.GetSheHe] hands me a letter of greeting, sealed by the Jade Viceroy [the_protector_general.GetHerselfHimself].
Not a complete failure, then.

[adventurous_spirit.GetTitledName] is back from [adventurous_spirit.GetHerHis] travels. When my council asks what [adventurous_spirit.GetSheHe] made of the [the_protector_general.Offmap.GetFullName], [adventurous_spirit.GetSheHe] sighs heavily and launches into a tirade about [adventurous_spirit.GetNegativeCathayanConvoTopic].
This is not what I had hoped for...
You lose a little grace.\n

[adventurous_spirit.GetTitledName] has finally come home from the [the_protector_general.Offmap.GetFullName]. Asked about [adventurous_spirit.GetHerHis] adventures, [adventurous_spirit.GetSheHe] only mutters about [adventurous_spirit.GetNegativeCathayanConvoTopic]. A letter from Taharq that arrived a week earlier tells the rest, in very polite and very cold words.
I should have sent someone else.
You lose some grace.\n

On the eve of [adventurous_spirit.GetHerHis] return from the [the_protector_general.Offmap.GetFullName], [adventurous_spirit.GetFirstName] and I talk at length about [adventurous_spirit.GetCathayanConvoTopic].\n'There is also someone I would like you to meet,' [adventurous_spirit.GetSheHe] says, smiling, as a stranger in Cathayan silks bows low at the door.
How lovely! Welcome to the [Root.PrimaryTitle.GetFullName]!
A [new_found_lover.GetManWoman] named §Y[new_found_lover.GetTitledName]§! joins your court.\n
You brought a stranger into our [Root.GetCapitalHolding]?
The stranger goes home to Cathay. §Y[adventurous_spirit.GetTitledFirstName]§! will not forgive you.\n

Something has changed in [adventurous_spirit.GetTitledFirstName]. As we talk of [adventurous_spirit.GetHerHis] travels to the [the_protector_general.Offmap.GetFullName], [adventurous_spirit.GetSheHe] speaks with a fire I have never seen about [adventurous_spirit.GetCathayanConvoTopic]. 'Oh, my [Root.GetLordLady],' [adventurous_spirit.GetSheHe] pleads. 'You must let me go back.'
If this is what you want...
What, you want to LIVE there?!
I am not sure I follow...
I... understand the wish to follow a dream.
§Y[adventurous_spirit.GetTitledFirstName]§! will leave your court forever.\n
§Y[adventurous_spirit.GetTitledFirstName]§! will leave your court forever, taking [adventurous_spirit.GetHerHis] spouse and young children.\n
Out of the question! You belong here in [Root.Capital.Capital.GetName].
§Y[adventurous_spirit.GetTitledFirstName]§! is furious.\n
Oh, [adventurous_spirit.GetFirstName]. Surely you do not mean that?
§Y[adventurous_spirit.GetTitledFirstName]§! will get over it.\n
How can you ask me to send you away again, [adventurous_spirit.GetFirstName]?

This option is available because §Y[adventurous_spirit.GetTitledName]§! thinks so highly of you.

Your [adventurous_spirit.GetRootRelation] bows [adventurous_spirit.GetHerHis] head and promises to stay.

A letter comes from Taharq, sealed in green wax. The Jade Viceroy writes, in careful and courteous phrases, that [adventurous_spirit.GetTitledFirstName] has died at the Viceroy's court, far from home, and was buried with all the rites the Celestial Empire grants an honoured guest.
At least [the_protector_general.GetTitledFirstName] sends [the_protector_general.GetHerHis] condolences.
Perhaps [adventurous_spirit.GetSheHe] at least enjoyed [adventurous_spirit.GetHerHis] last days abroad.\n
how the Celestial Empire is so full of life, and there are people everywhere
how the realm is so wealthy, and every inch of the Celestial Empire seems to be used to house or feed its people

[Root.GetGovernorLetterGreeting]. [Root.GetCathayanLetterBlessing].\n\nThe [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetCathayanComplimentAdjective] [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetTitle] [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetFullName] has decreed that a new city shall rise on the roads that link the Celestial Empire to the West, where caravans may rest and jade and silk change hands. The lord who founds it first will enjoy the Emperor's favour in trade, and [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetHerHis] personal notice. You are one of those the Jade Viceroy has named to the task.

[Root.GetGovernorLetterGreeting]. [Root.GetCathayanLetterBlessing].\n\nThe [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetCathayanComplimentAdjective] [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetTitle] [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetFullName] wishes to know which of the lords of the West is the most worthy to trade with the Celestial Empire. In five years the Jade Viceroy will judge who among those named has won the greatest renown, and that lord will enjoy the Emperor's favour in trade, and [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetHerHis] personal notice.
Failure is not an option...
To win, be the first contestant to build a new §YCity§! holding in a province on the Ivory Road, the Old Silk Road, the Khyprian Road or the Spice Route, within five years.\n
To win, gain more §YPrestige§! than any other contestant over the next five years.\n

[Root.GetGovernorLetterGreeting]. [Root.GetCathayanLetterBlessing].\n\nThe [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetCathayanComplimentAdjective] [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetTitle] [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetFullName] is most pleased with the city of [trade_competition_new_city.GetName], which you raised on the road east. The caravans already speak of its markets. To show [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetHerHis] appreciation, the Celestial Empire grants you its favour.

[Root.GetGovernorLetterGreeting]. [Root.GetCathayanLetterBlessing].\n\nThe [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetCathayanComplimentAdjective] [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetTitle] [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetFullName] is most pleased with the city of [trade_competition_new_city.GetName], which [trade_competition_winner.GetTitledName] raised on the road east. Your own lack of zeal for trade with the Celestial Empire has also been noted.
To be noticed by the Dragon Emperor himself!
I must try harder next time.

[Root.GetGovernorLetterGreeting]. [Root.GetCathayanLetterBlessing].\n\nThe [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetCathayanComplimentAdjective] [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetTitle] [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetFullName] is most displeased that not one of the lords named by the Jade Viceroy has raised so much as a market on the roads east in five years. [offmap_cathay.Ruler.GetHerHisCap] disappointment is great, and it will not soon be forgotten.
Alas! Woe to us all...
Pleasant rumours reach my court from the East: the Jade Viceroy is said to think me the most worthy of those competing for the Emperor's favour.
Rumours reach my court from the East: the Jade Viceroy is said to think [trade_competition_halftime_winner.GetTitledName] the most worthy of those competing for the Emperor's favour.
Of course I am.
Keep winning more renown than the other contestants to win.\n
I must work harder to deserve it...
Win more renown than the other contestants before the five years are up.\n

[Root.GetGovernorLetterGreeting]. [Root.GetCathayanLetterBlessing].\n\nThe [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetCathayanComplimentAdjective] [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetTitle] [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetFullName] has heard much of the esteem you command among your peers, more than any other the Jade Viceroy named. The Celestial Empire is honoured to call you its friend.

[Root.GetGovernorLetterGreeting]. [Root.GetCathayanLetterBlessing].\n\nThe [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetCathayanComplimentAdjective] [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetTitle] [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetFullName] has heard much of the esteem [trade_competition_winner.GetTitledName] commands among [trade_competition_winner.GetHerHis] peers. Your own renown, however, fell short.

A noble named [escaped_cathayan_noble.GetFullName] came to court today, dusty from the long road west, and begged for asylum. [escaped_cathayan_noble.GetSheHeCap] says [escaped_cathayan_noble.GetHerHis] whole family fell from favour at the Celestial Court and was put to death by order of the Dragon Emperor, and that [escaped_cathayan_noble.GetSheHe] alone escaped over the Great Bastion. 'Great [Root.GetTitle], your mercy is known even in the East. Grant me refuge, and I will never forget it.'
Of course you may stay.
§Y[escaped_cathayan_noble.GetFullName]§! may stay at your court.\n
Is there, perhaps, a price on your head?
§Y[escaped_cathayan_noble.GetFullName]§! may stay, and you secretly write to the Jade Viceroy.\n
I dare not anger the Dragon.
You send §Y[escaped_cathayan_noble.GetFullName]§! away, so as not to anger the Dragon Emperor.\n

[Root.GetGovernorLetterGreeting]. [Root.GetCathayanLetterBlessing].\n\nIt has come to the attention of the [From.Offmap.Ruler.GetShortCathayanEmperorName] that you shelter [escaped_cathayan_noble.GetFullName], a traitor condemned by the Celestial Court. If the traitor is not handed over to the Jade Viceroy's guards at once, the Dragon will be most displeased.
Then I had better hand [escaped_cathayan_noble.GetHerHim] over.
§Y[From.GetTitledFirstName]§! receives your reply.\n
I do not fear the Emperor!
§Y[From.GetTitledFirstName]§! receives your reply.\n

Despite [escaped_cathayan_noble.GetFullName]'s fears, no envoy of the Dragon Emperor has come looking for [escaped_cathayan_noble.GetHerHim]. 'The time has come for me to go further west, where no one knows my name. I will never forget your kindness. Please, take this in thanks.'
I will treasure it always.
§Y[escaped_cathayan_noble.GetFirstName]§! leaves your court.\n

Soon after my letter reached Taharq, an envoy of the Jade Viceroy came with a dozen jade-armoured guards to take [escaped_cathayan_noble.GetFullName] back east, with many thanks. 'You do not know what they will do to me!' [escaped_cathayan_noble.GetFirstName] screamed as [escaped_cathayan_noble.GetSheHe] was dragged out to the waiting cart.
Surely it cannot be that bad?

An envoy of the Jade Viceroy came with a dozen jade-armoured guards, but [escaped_cathayan_noble.GetFullName] had fled the night before. Someone must have warned [escaped_cathayan_noble.GetHerHim]. All the envoy said before leaving was: 'The Dragon will be... displeased.'
What a fool I look.

[escaped_cathayan_noble.GetFullName] was found dead in [escaped_cathayan_noble.GetHerHis] room this morning, strangled with a cord of the finest Cathayan silk. The killer was gone without a trace, but I have no doubt who sent them.
No one escapes the Dragon.
